name: FAQ, two columns
description: A heading, an intro and questions in two columns that open one at a time.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: Answers before you book a demo

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: The questions research and security teams ask us most. Something missing? Write to support@fieldnote.example.

default.question: Do customers know they are being recorded?
default.answer: Yes. Fieldnote announces itself when it joins a call, and you can send a consent note with every invite.

default.question: Which calling tools does Fieldnote work with?
default.answer: Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams. For in-person interviews, record with our phone app or upload the file.

default.question: How accurate are the transcripts?
default.answer: Around 95% for clear audio in English, with speaker labels. You can fix any line, and the clip timing follows your edit.

default.question: Where is our data stored?
default.answer: In the region you choose: the EU, the US or Canada. Recordings are encrypted at rest and in transit.

default.question: Can we import interviews we already recorded?
default.answer: Drop in audio or video files, or connect your cloud drive. Past interviews are transcribed and tagged like new ones.

default.question: Can personal details be removed from transcripts?
default.answer: Turn on redaction per project, and names, emails, phone numbers and card numbers are masked before anyone reads them.

default.question: Who counts as an editor?
default.answer: Anyone who tags, writes or uploads. People who only read reports and watch clips are viewers, and viewers are free.

default.question: What happens when the trial ends?
default.answer: Nothing is deleted. Pick a plan to keep editing, or stay on Starter to keep reading what you have.
